crude_marriage_rate.source: 內政部戶政司 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 結婚及離婚 01. 結婚對數及粗結婚率(按登記)
crude_marriage_rate.notes: Registration basis. 1961-1973 exclude Kinmen & Matsu. From 2019 includes same-sex marriages (2025: 3,305 of 104,376). Replaces earlier partial/estimated values (2017-2022 were previously est). Years 1947–1947 not in this official source (1 values) are kept from the earlier secondary source: 內政部戶政司/統計處 via news (udn 2026, Advisers 2020, 亮亮喵讀經濟); est years computed = marriages / mid-year population (births.json population)

marriages.source: 內政部戶政司 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 結婚及離婚 01. 結婚對數及粗結婚率(按登記)
marriages.notes: Registration basis; 1961-1973 exclude Kinmen & Matsu; same-sex couples included from 2019 (2019-05-24 law).

crude_divorce_rate.source: 內政部戶政司 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 結婚及離婚 07. 離婚對數及粗離婚率(按登記)
crude_divorce_rate.notes: Registration basis; 1961-1973 exclude Kinmen & Matsu; includes same-sex 終止結婚 from 2019. Peak 2.87 in 2003. Years 1947–1947 not in this official source (1 values) are kept from the earlier secondary source: 內政部 via 亮亮喵讀經濟, 監察院 report (cy.gov.tw), udn 2026, Wang & Schofer-style decomposition paper (PMC5991100) for early-1990s average

mean_age_first_marriage.source: 內政部戶政司 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 結婚及離婚 06. 結婚年齡中位數及平均數(按發生)
mean_age_first_marriage.unit: years (mean and median age at first marriage of brides/grooms married that year)
mean_age_first_marriage.notes: Occurrence basis. Official series starts 1975; 1961-1974 not published in this table (older values only exist in printed yearbooks) — earlier life-table estimates (1980/2005) dropped in favour of the official series. The 1998 dip reflects a change in data processing (new household-registration system) in the source.

divorces.source: 內政部戶政司 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 結婚及離婚 07. 離婚對數及粗離婚率(按登記)

first_marriage_rate.source: 內政部戶政司 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 結婚及離婚 02. 結婚對數、初(再)婚人數(按發生)
first_marriage_rate.unit: first-marriage rate = first marriages per 1000 never-married population aged 15+ of that sex; remarriage rate per 1000 divorced/widowed 15+; counts in persons

marriages_by_age_group_sex.source: 內政部戶政司 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 結婚及離婚 04. 結婚人數按年齡(按發生) (結婚人數按性別、五歲年齡組及結婚次數分)
marriages_by_age_group_sex.unit: persons marrying in year by own age group; male/female = all marriages, first_male/first_female = first marriages only
marriages_by_age_group_sex.notes: Occurrence basis, 1975-2025; same-sex marriages included from 2019. Source error: the published 2020 all-marriage male row double-counts the 25-29 cell (row sum 124,931 vs total 119,357); replaced by first+remarriage rows, which sum exactly to the total. Fixed years: 2020.

marriage_rate_by_age_sex.source: Derived: marriages_by_age_group_sex (y4s4) / mid-year population by sex & 5-year age (歷年全國人口統計資料 04. 年中人口按性別及五齡組, y1s9)
marriage_rate_by_age_sex.url: https://www.ris.gov.tw/info-popudata/app/awFastDownload/view (POST m4c=y4s4, type=xls; via https://www.ris.gov.tw/app/portal/346) ; https://www.ris.gov.tw/info-popudata/app/awFastDownload/view (POST m4c=y1s9, type=xls; via https://www.ris.gov.tw/app/portal/346)
marriage_rate_by_age_sex.unit: persons marrying (any order) per 1000 mid-year population of same sex and age group
marriage_rate_by_age_sex.notes: Computed here from two official MOI tables (not itself an official published series); 1975-2025. MOI publishes age-specific first-marriage rates relative to never-married population only in recent yearbooks; not used. For first-marriage hazards use first_male/first_female counts with the never-married population (not included).
